fields.title: Regenerating the pairing code stores one encrypted token
fields.description: `regenerate-ws-pairing-token` stores the token through a new `encodePairingToken` in `main/ws-server.js`, which `startServer` also uses with a matching `decodePairingToken`. One token exists, with no plaintext under safeStorage. Fold-ins: `schemaVersion` becomes optional in `BlurbySettings`, and a parity test checks `BlurbySettings` against `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS`.
